articles.detail: 5 cycles scheduled, 4 published (11 + 12 + 9 + 3); the 04:04 cycle shipped 0 after the writer stalled on a permission prompt

experiment: Skipped — the noNewExperimentsUntil gate (2026-07-28) covering the Opus 4.8 → Opus 5 migration is still in force, and no experiments are active to evaluate. Every headline metric is inside target regardless.
weakestArea: Science is weakest on both counts: volume sat exactly on the 5/day floor, down from 11 yesterday, and every science story came from a general-interest outlet — Liverpool Echo, Aol, Hindustan Times, Global Voices, Dawn. Yesterday's specialist bench (Nature, Phys.org, New Scientist, Carbon Brief) appeared nowhere today, so the educational-value goal's 'from quality sources' half missed even though the ratio target passed at 31%.
watching: India's NEET paper leak escalated within a day — Delhi shut 18 metro stations, then education minister Pradhan resigned; the concession-versus-continued-protest arc is unresolved.
Russian strikes on Chornomorsk and Mykolaiv ports reach grain insurance pricing, a lever with wider economic consequence than the strike itself.
North Korea's reported 30,000 additional troops to Russia turns the manpower-export story from a one-off deployment into a sustained arrangement.
Sudan's Burhan-Asmara ceasefire track against continued RSF drone activity via Chad — early, and prior tracks have collapsed.
Saudi airstrikes on Hodeida port against Yemeni missiles at King Khalid airbase: an exchange with direct food-import consequences.
Pakistan's Chenab flood warning at barrage thresholds — slow-onset, worth holding open.
coverageGaps: Africa produced 2 of 35 articles and Oceania none; the AF share more than halved from yesterday's 5.
No specialist science outlet published to the site today, leaving all five science articles on general-interest sourcing.
Latin America appears only inside the AM bucket, which US coverage dominates — Venezuela earthquake financing was the sole distinctly Latin American piece.
Tech clears its floor at 6 but leans on crypto and finance (CoinDesk, Robinhood, Sberbank) rather than research or infrastructure reporting.
context: The 04:04 cycle selected 13 fresh stories, enriched all 13 and passed dedup, then the writer exited 0 after 17 seconds having asked for approval to run a command against /tmp/zuhd-selection.json — a Bash call it does not have and did not need, since Read covers that file. All 13 stories were lost and the day's output fell to 35 from 59. This is the same failure class as the July 1-3 Edit-tool incident, but it is the only occurrence in 41 July cycles, so it reads as an isolated model choice rather than a configuration fault; TOOLS_WRITER is already Read,Write,Edit and run-cycle.sh sits outside the tunable-parameter scope. Flagged, not changed — if it recurs the fix is a writer-stage guard that fails the cycle loudly when the writer exits 0 with no new files, instead of proceeding silently to briefing and deploy. Standing constraints unchanged: the selector multi-source floor lever is exhausted, and TOP_EVENTS_TO_FETCH stays at 8 because each unit is one NewsAPI token per cycle.
